metadata.title: संस्थानों की प्रतिष्ठा या आदिवासी छात्रों की जान | Stress or Discrimination- What kills students
metadata.description: Chief justice of India has recently shown concern on the increase in number of suicides in the premier institutions of the country. He pointed out that more than half of the such students come from adivasi and Dalit communities. He said that it shows that our great institutions lack empathy for deprived sections of the society.
